observations: The two additive snapshots are indexed copies, not conversions of SVI current or voltage.
The third additive source is a local polynomial whose coefficient and input units remain unverified.
Two polynomial inputs have an explicit 0.001-coded register-cache source; register physical identity remains unknown.
No original instructions in the completed polynomial function read the SVI converted-telemetry range.
No link from a verified watt scale to the unknown core/CCD model coefficients has been established.
boundaries: Synthetic registers, coefficient tables, byte selectors and finite inputs are not runtime captures.
Selector 0..255 address checks are not a declaration of 256 supported firmware modes.
Two slices enter with explicit incoming-register fixtures; the separate MMIO initializer prefix also stops before its remaining side effects.
No global writer-completeness claim; indirect memory updates, board calibration and loader patches remain unresolved.
Binary32 rounding/FPU exceptions outside the stated domains are not simulated.
No change to GUI/CLI labels, units, controls or physical/OS mapping.
The retained instruction inventory is from earlier study run 42432173976; this supplement does not establish new REA evidence IDs.
The polynomial read inventory contains accesses during original-instruction replay only, excluding host assertion reads.
The trace digest records deterministic case identities and results, not peripheral captures or a claim of full CPU emulation.
This does not repeat or replace the cloud-validated SMU consumer/MP5-transfer proofs; the three additive producers were studied separately.
No production or analysis source is modified; all new supplement files are under build.
These local-only cases must not be counted in cloud proof totals, hardware acceptance or restored physical-unit totals.

hob_apob_connection.new_connection: The Granite producer module separately publishes APOB descriptor GUID 30b174f3-7712-4cca-bd13-d0b8a8801997: byte0=1, dword+4=selected APOB header size at +8, qword+8=selected-query address. Existing APOB providers consume this descriptor prefix. The core-status HOB is not an input to that publication.
not_proven: Query selector0x61 acquisition and provenance; only its output context was supplied to the replay.
Origin, completeness or HMAC of an actual APOB group3/type3 topology record.
A field-level edge from 528-byte core-status local core bits to APOB stored IDs or APIC enumeration ordinals.
Runtime equivalence of HOB low8 mask and SMU low16 mask, or control bit8 and SMT bit10.
hob_apob_connection.consequence: No automatic HOB-to-APOB or PM/OS binding is justified. Shared GUID also occurs in two separately gated producer modules and cannot authenticate a 9950X3D record.
